evidence.title: Chatwoot Pricing: Free, Cloud & Self-Hosted Plans
Chatwoot Help Center and Product Documentation

name: Chatwoot
summary: Open-source, self-hosted customer support desk that funnels live chat, email, WhatsApp and social channels into one inbox.
description: An omnichannel support platform and Intercom/Zendesk alternative: website live chat, email, WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, SMS and more land in a shared inbox with teams, labels, canned responses, automation, a help center portal, an AI support agent (Captain) and CSAT reports. Self-host free or use the paid cloud plans.
contains: omnichannel inbox: live chat, email, Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, WhatsApp, Telegram, Line, SMS
Captain AI agent for automated replies
built-in help center portal for articles and FAQs
collaboration: private notes, @mentions, labels, canned responses, auto-assignment, teams
integrations: Slack, Dialogflow, Shopify, Linear, Google Translate
reports: conversation, agent, inbox, label, team, CSAT
self-host via Heroku or DigitalOcean one-click; MIT licensed
cloud plans: free up to 2 agents, then $19 per agent per month
